name: jpy-datareader
what_it_holds: Python package (MIT, 26 stars, requires Python >=3.12) providing pandas-DataReader-style remote access to Japan's e-Stat portal: keyword search across statistics tables, metadata retrieval, automatic pagination past 100k rows, filtering by region/time/classification. Covers population/households, labor/wages, agriculture-forestry-fisheries fields explicitly in docs; e-Stat itself also hosts Japan Tourism Statistics / Survey of Overnight Travel Statistics tables reachable the same way. No data committed, code only.
why_useful: Gap #7 (APAC regional travel volume -- Japan named explicitly). e-Stat is the underlying source for Japan overnight-stay/accommodation survey data (a JNTO-adjacent official series); this client makes it machine-pullable instead of manual portal downloads.
themes: Regional macro for LatAm and APAC: Mexico INEGI/Banxico, Brazil IBGE/BCB, Argentina INDEC, Colombia DANE, Chile, Japan e-Stat, Korea KOSIS, Australia ABS, India MOSPI clients
why_all: Gap #7 (APAC regional travel volume -- Japan named explicitly). e-Stat is the underlying source for Japan overnight-stay/accommodation survey data (a JNTO-adjacent official series); this client makes it machine-pullable instead of manual portal downloads.

name: eurostat/hicp
what_it_holds: Official Eurostat R package (data.table-based, ~84 commits, 3 stars) providing functions to pull HICP price indices AND item weights from Eurostat's public database at any COICOP level, including the accommodation/restaurants-and-hotels aggregates and the finer 'accommodation services' class. Not a static dataset — a live API client maintained by Eurostat itself, so country x COICOP x month panels are one function call away.
why_useful: We already hold euro-area HICP accommodation, but this is the maintained official tool (vs. a one-off pull) — lets the team refresh/extend country-level HICP accommodation and restaurants/hotels series easily, including point-in-time re-pulls (gap #4). Duplicate of what we hold in substance but materially better tooling.
duplicate_of_holding: euro-area HICP accommodation (already held), but this is the maintained upstream access method rather than a static pull
time_coverage: Full Eurostat HICP history via API (typically 1996/2000-present depending on country)
license: unspecified in fetched README (Eurostat GitHub org)
last_activity: actively maintained (84 commits; recent per repo page)
themes: Inflation and price indices for accommodation: BLS CPI lodging, Eurostat HICP accommodation, national CPI hotel components, Japan CPI, Australia CPI accommodation
why_all: We already hold euro-area HICP accommodation, but this is the maintained official tool (vs. a one-off pull) — lets the team refresh/extend country-level HICP accommodation and restaurants/hotels series easily, including point-in-time re-pulls (gap #4). Duplicate of what we hold in substance but materially better tooling.

name: sabers13/Eurostat-HICP
what_it_holds: Repo explicitly described as 'Inflation trends (EU, country, COICOP) with YoY/MoM, weights, drilldowns' — i.e. a build that ingests Eurostat HICP by COICOP category (which includes accommodation services / restaurants-hotels) with weights and country drilldowns.
why_useful: If it commits the COICOP-level output (not just code), it's a ready-made country x category HICP panel that could isolate accommodation services inflation by country, finer than the aggregate euro-area series we hold.
duplicate_of_holding: possibly duplicates euro-area HICP accommodation holding at coarser level; finer COICOP/country drilldown would be new
themes: Inflation and price indices for accommodation: BLS CPI lodging, Eurostat HICP accommodation, national CPI hotel components, Japan CPI, Australia CPI accommodation

name: paluigi-moltis/hicp-weights-downloader
what_it_holds: Python script pulling Eurostat's HICP item-weight tables (dataset prc_hicp_inw or similar) via the Eurostat API into a Parquet file `hicp_weights.parquet`, plus a committed `coicop18.csv` ECOICOP v2 classification mapping. Covers EU + EA aggregates and all 27 EU member states, annual weights from the total index down to the most granular published level (e.g. CP0111A), including the accommodation-services / restaurants-and-hotels branch. No pre-downloaded weight data is committed; the classification CSV is.
why_useful: Useful complement if the team needs accommodation-services expenditure weights by country/year to weight or decompose HICP moves — a narrow but concrete gap-filler for point-in-time HICP construction (gap #4).
duplicate_of_holding: no direct duplicate; weights are a different quantity than the HICP accommodation index we hold
time_coverage: annual, full Eurostat HICP weights history
size_hint: small parquet output (not yet confirmed committed to repo)
themes: Inflation and price indices for accommodation: BLS CPI lodging, Eurostat HICP accommodation, national CPI hotel components, Japan CPI, Australia CPI accommodation
why_all: Useful complement if the team needs accommodation-services expenditure weights by country/year to weight or decompose HICP moves — a narrow but concrete gap-filler for point-in-time HICP construction (gap #4).

Gives the exact COICOP weight of 'accommodation services' inside each country's HICP basket, letting the team re-weight or decompose Eurostat HICP-accommodation moves by country rather than treating the euro-area print as one number — useful for the EMEA regional ADR/pricing bridge and for understanding why HICP-accommodation swings differ from Airbnb's EMEA mix.

name: agscott/AustralianCPI
what_it_holds: R project (CC0-1.0 licensed) that pulls the quarterly Australian CPI via the ABS API (script `1 ReadABS_API.R`), stores a processed `CPI.RData`, and renders an RMarkdown report (example output `Australian CPI 2023-Q2.html`). ABS CPI publishes a 'Domestic holiday travel and accommodation' expenditure class, so this pipeline is a plausible one-command route to that subcomponent, though the specific breakdown committed in CPI.RData was not confirmed by README alone.
why_useful: Directly targets the theme's 'Australia CPI accommodation' ask; CC0 license and a working ABS-API pull script make it easy to adapt/re-run for the accommodation/domestic-travel expenditure class specifically, which we do not otherwise hold.
duplicate_of_holding: no — we hold no Australia CPI series currently
time_coverage: at least through 2023-Q2 per the committed HTML report; API pull could extend further
size_hint: single CPI.RData file + one HTML report; small
themes: Inflation and price indices for accommodation: BLS CPI lodging, Eurostat HICP accommodation, national CPI hotel components, Japan CPI, Australia CPI accommodation
why_all: Directly targets the theme's 'Australia CPI accommodation' ask; CC0 license and a working ABS-API pull script make it easy to adapt/re-run for the accommodation/domestic-travel expenditure class specifically, which we do not otherwise hold.
